name: Dancing with a Beautiful Robot
source:
In a company where romance is forbidden, having feelings for your boss isn't the best idea. But that can be difficult—especially when your boss is Mettaton, the popstar robot from the underground.

It's been two years since the breaking of the barrier, and when a rival TV channel tries to imitate Mettaton's style, it's up to [i]you[/i], his most prized choreographer, to create a new dance for next week's show.

Staying professional isn't easy when Mettaton is by your side, whispering promises of a surprise when this is all over.

Will you contain your feelings or let them guide your path?

Drama! Romance! Bloodsh—[i]Dance![/i]

This week, your destiny is up to you when you're [i]dancing with a beautiful robot[/i]!

[From [url=https://khywae.itch.io/dancing-with-a-beautiful-robot]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个禁止浪漫的公司里，对老板产生感情并不是最好的主意。但这可能很困难，尤其是当你的老板是来自地下的流行歌星机器人Mettaton时。

打破障碍已经过去两年了，当竞争对手的电视频道试图模仿Mettaton的风格时，他最欣赏的编舞师 [i]you[/i] 需要为下周的节目创作新的舞蹈。

当Mettaton在你身边时，保持专业并不容易，当这一切结束时，他低声承诺会给你一个惊喜。

你会抑制自己的感受还是让它们引导你的道路？

戏剧！浪漫！血腥——[i]跳舞！[/i]

本周，当你[i]与美丽的机器人跳舞[/i]时，你的命运就由你决定！

[来自[url=https://khywae.itch.io/dancing-with-a-beautiful-robot]itch.io[/url]]
